# Keeping It Green Lawn Care Solutions

> Professional lawn fertilization, pest control, tree & shrub care, vegetation control, and landscaping services in Berks County, PA.

## About
Keeping It Green Lawn Care Solutions is a lawn care and landscaping company serving Berks County, PA and surrounding areas. We specialize in soil-science-based lawn care — "We test, we don't guess." Services include lawn fertilization programs, pest control, tree & shrub care, vegetation control, and landscaping.

## Services
- Lawn Care: Custom fertilization programs, weed control, grub prevention, soil testing, aeration & overseeding.
- Tree & Shrub Care: Deep root feeding, insect & disease management, seasonal treatments.
- Vegetation Control: Total vegetation management for commercial and industrial properties.
- Landscaping: Design, installation, mulching, hardscaping, seasonal cleanups.
